snippet.title: An AI finds my website's biggest conversion leak every Monday
snippet.description:
I gave an AI access to my website's code. Every Monday it finds the biggest conversion leak, writes the code fix, and sends it to my Telegram. I reply YES and it ships. If bounce rate rises after a change, one YES rolls it back.

This is Velyr, an AI growth agent for conversion rate optimization. Works with your GitHub repo or your Shopify store — you approve every change before it goes live.

https://velyr.io — 14-day free trial, cancel anytime.
